sentences.en: How those candidates, who agree on so many social issues, are fighting to distinguish themselves in order to beat President Trump.
sentences.zh: 在许多社会议题上持相同观点的候选人，正如何通过脱颖而出，以击败特朗普总统。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, February 20th.

sentences.en: I'm here today to declare that I am a candidate for president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 我今天来这里宣布，我将竞选美国总统。

sentences.en: To announce my candidacy for president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 宣布我竞选美国总统。

sentences.en: Candidacy for president of the United States.

sentences.en: I'm filing an exploratory committee for president of the United States tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚我将为竞选美国总统提交一个探索委员会。

sentences.en: I'm running for president because I want to address these issues.
sentences.zh: 我参选总统是因为我想解决这些问题。

sentences.zh: 嗨，我是伯尼·桑德斯。

sentences.en: I'm running for president.
sentences.zh: 我正在竞选总统。

sentences.en: And I'm asking you today to be part of an unprecedented grassroots campaign.
sentences.zh: 今天我请求你们加入一场前所未有的基层运动。

sentences.en: And we are going to do this again.
sentences.zh: 我们将再次这样做。

sentences.en: Alex Burns, what does Bernie Sanders' announcement mean for the 2020 presidential race?
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·伯恩斯，伯尼·桑德斯的宣布对2020年总统大选意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, it really means that now we have a full spectrum of Democratic candidates running from sort of quasi-Marxist to avowedly moderate.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这确实意味着现在我们有了一个从准马克思主义者到公开温和派的完整民主党候选人谱系。

sentences.en: That might sound like we now have this messy, shapeless field.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能像是我们现在有了一个混乱、没有固定形状的阵营。

sentences.en: But in reality, they are all basically debating the same central question, which is who has what it takes to beat Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 但实际上，他们基本上都在争论同一个核心问题，那就是谁有能力击败唐纳德·特朗普？

sentences.en: All the candidates, all the voters from different wings of the party basically agree that that is the overarching theme of this primary.
sentences.zh: 所有候选人、党内不同派别的所有选民基本上都同意，这是这场初选的最核心主题。

sentences.en: They just all have different answers to that basic question.
sentences.zh: 他们只是对这个基本问题有不同的答案。

sentences.en: And as these Democratic candidates debate visions for beating Trump, I have to imagine that is a calculation about moving left and embracing kind of the politics of identity
sentences.zh: 随着这些民主党候选人辩论击败特朗普的愿景，我想这其中必然包含着关于向左转并拥抱身份政治的盘算，

sentences.en: or tacking to the right to go after Trump voters, moderates.
sentences.zh: 或者转向右翼以争取特朗普选民和温和党人。

sentences.en: Well, you're sort of half right there that there is a debate about whether the party needs to move to the left or to the center.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你的说法对了一半，党内确实存在一场关于是需要向左转还是向中转的辩论。

sentences.en: But the fault lines are almost entirely about the economy, that when it comes to matters of identity and different social justice issues, there's very,
sentences.zh: 但分歧几乎完全围绕着经济，而当涉及到身份认同和不同的社会正义问题时，

sentences.en: very little disagreement across the field.
sentences.zh: 整个阵营的分歧非常、非常小。

sentences.en: When you think about the issues that are now just consensus positions in the Democratic Party, support for gay marriage, support for abortion rights,
sentences.zh: 当你想到那些现在已经成为民主党内共识的议题时，比如支持同性婚姻、支持堕胎权、

sentences.en: support for very restrictive gun control laws, I don't know that you would have had a field.
sentences.zh: 支持非常严格的枪支管制法律，我不知道你是否还能找到这样一个阵营。

sentences.en: We didn't have a field 10 years ago, 15, 20 years ago, where there was basically no daylight on any of those issues, that the party is a liberal party on cultural matters.
sentences.zh: 10年前、15年、20年前，我们可没有这样一个在所有这些议题上基本没有分歧的阵营，这个党在文化事务上是一个自由派政党。

sentences.en: And the candidates themselves obviously have very different identities.
sentences.zh: 候选人本身显然有着非常不同的身份。

sentences.en: But in terms of where they are on those issues, there's not a great deal of daylight.
sentences.zh: 但在他们在这些议题上的立场方面，并没有太大的分歧。

sentences.en: When it comes to stuff like health care and taxation and financial regulation, that's when you start to see the differences really open up.
sentences.zh: 而当谈到医疗保健、税收和金融监管之类的事情时，你才会开始看到分歧真正显现出来。

sentences.en: That right now is where the Democratic debate is going to focus.
sentences.zh: 这正是目前民主党辩论将要聚焦的地方。

sentences.en: I guess I'm curious, why is there such a wide spectrum on economic issues where there isn't when it comes to social issues?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，为什么在社会议题上没有广泛分歧的经济议题上，会有如此广泛的谱系？

sentences.en: Well, this is going to get very weighty very faSt. But I think you can look back over the last
sentences.zh: 嗯，这个话题很快就会变得非常沉重。但我认为你可以回过去看看过去

sentences.en: decade since the Great Recession and see just an enormous opening up of the range of economic debate
sentences.zh: 十年大衰退以来的情况，就会发现美国政治中经济辩论范围的大幅扩展，

sentences.en: in American politics, that in 1992 or 2000, you didn't have candidates running for the Democratic
sentences.zh: 在1992年或2000年，你不会看到竞选民主党

sentences.en: nomination for president calling themselves Democratic Socialists or calling for just a colossal rewriting of the American economy.
sentences.zh: 总统提名的候选人自称是民主社会主义者，或者呼吁对美国经济进行彻底的重塑。

sentences.en: Now you have most candidates not calling themselves
sentences.zh: 而现在大多数候选人虽然不自称是

sentences.en: Democratic Socialists, but calling for really transformational change of some kind or another.
sentences.zh: 民主社会主义者，但都在呼吁某种形式的真正变革。

sentences.en: I think you can find the roots to that in the recession.
sentences.zh: 我认为你可以在大萧条中找到这种现象的根源。

sentences.en: I think you can find the roots to that in Bernie Sanders in 2015.
sentences.zh: 我认为你可以在2015年的伯尼·桑德斯身上找到根源。

sentences.en: And finally, I think you can see the Trump presidency just as an enormously disruptive force in this space.
sentences.zh: 最后，我认为你可以看到特朗普总统在这个领域中扮演了一个极具颠覆性的角色。

sentences.en: I think Democrats, liberal Democrats, see how the president blew up the debate around economics on the Republican side, especially on matters like
sentences.zh: 我认为民主党人，自由派民主党人，看到了总统是如何在经济辩论上炸毁了共和党这一边的阵营，特别是在

sentences.en: trade and just the nature of the global economy.
sentences.zh: 贸易以及全球经济本质等问题上。

sentences.en: And there's no reason now for folks on the left not to do the same thing on their side.
sentences.zh: 现在左翼人士没有任何理由不在他们自己这一边做同样的事情。

sentences.en: It's kind of their turn to be incredibly disruptive when it comes to economics.
sentences.zh: 在经济问题上，现在轮到他们来进行令人难以置信的颠覆了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they don't have on the right a mainstream traditional Republican president who they worry will make them look outside the mainstream.
sentences.zh: 而且他们右边没有一个主流的传统共和党总统，让他们担心会让自己显得脱离主流。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That if you are campaigning against a President Jeb Bush or a President Marco Rubio who passed a very traditional modest middle-class
sentences.zh: 如果你是在对抗杰布·布什总统或马可·鲁比奥总统，他们通过了一个非常传统的温和的中产阶级

sentences.en: tax cut and who says the right things about economic inequality and pursues sort of modest tinkering to NAFTA, I think Democrats probably do feel a little bit more trepidation
sentences.zh: 减税政策，并且在经济不平等问题上说了正确的话，对北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA）进行了温和的修补，我想民主党人大概会

sentences.en: about campaigning on a really daring, disruptive, relatively far-left agenda.
sentences.zh: 对带着一个真正大胆、颠覆性、相对偏左的议程进行竞选感到更多一丝担忧。

sentences.en: That's not the mood of the Democratic Party right now.
sentences.zh: 那不是现在民主党人的主流情绪。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Instead, you have a candidate on the right, an almost assured nominee, who deliberately provokes trade wars and tears up almost every major economic agreement
sentences.zh: 相反，你有一个右翼候选人，一个几乎板上钉钉的提名人，他故意挑起贸易战，撕毁了我们在过去25年中

sentences.en: we have signed as a country in the last 25 years.
sentences.zh: 作为国家签署的几乎每一项重大经济协议。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So Democrats aren't looking at Donald Trump and saying, we need to really make sure that we reassure the business community and make sure that we
sentences.zh: 所以民主党人不会看着唐纳德·特朗普说，我们需要确保安抚商界，确保我们

sentences.en: don't, you know, make folks on the center-right nervous because the president does those things already.
sentences.zh: 不会，你知道的，让中右翼的人感到紧张，因为总统已经做过这些事情了。

sentences.en: So I think from Democrats close to the middle to Democrats well to the left, there is just this universal feeling that they've got to go big on an economic vision in some way.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，从接近中间派的民主党人到偏左的民主党人，都有这样一种普遍的感受，那就是他们必须在经济愿景上有所大动作。

sentences.en: So let's start off at the most disruptive end of the economic spectrum here.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们从经济谱系最具颠覆性的一端开始吧。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是伯尼·桑德斯。

sentences.en: I'm running for president.
sentences.zh: 我正在竞选总统。

sentences.en: I imagine that that is Bernie Sanders, right?
sentences.zh: 我想那是伯尼·桑德斯，对吧？

sentences.en: Why does he believe that he is best positioned to beat President Trump?
sentences.zh: 为什么他相信自己最有优势击败特朗普总统？

sentences.en: Our campaign is about taking on the powerful special interests that dominate our economic and political life.
sentences.zh: 我们的竞选旨在挑战主导我们经济和政治生活的强大特殊利益集团。

sentences.en: Well, the Sanders theory of the case in 2019 is very similar to what his theory was in 2015 and 2016, which is that if you're running against a candidate in Donald Trump and
sentences.zh: 嗯，桑德斯在2019年的竞选逻辑与他在2015年和2016年的逻辑非常相似，那就是如果你对抗的是唐纳德·特朗普这样的候选人，以及

sentences.en: a political party like the Republican Party that is defined in the eyes of many voters as a party of

sentences.zh: 并与强大企业利益结盟的共和党这样的政党，你就应当直面这些巨大的财富和强大的企业利益。

sentences.en: And we are the wealthiest nation in the history of the world.
sentences.zh: 我们是世界历史上最富有的国家。

sentences.en: We should not have a grotesque level of wealth inequality in which three billionaires now own more wealth than the bottom half of the country.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该拥有这种荒谬的财富不平等水平，即三位亿万富翁拥有的财富超过了全国半数底层人口。

sentences.en: Part of what has won him the passionate following he has is his directness in marshalling people's sense of political alienation and economic
sentences.zh: 他之所以赢得狂热的追随者，部分原因在于他直言不讳地以一种真正的阶级导向的方式来调动人们的政治疏离感和经济

sentences.en: dissatisfaction in a really class oriented way.
sentences.zh: 不满情绪。

sentences.en: Our campaign is about creating a government and economy that works for the many, not just the few.
sentences.zh: 我们的竞选旨在建立一个为大多数人而不是少数人服务的政府和经济。

sentences.en: He talks about trying to, you know, bring together voters who are economically distressed across lines of geography and culture and race
sentences.zh: 他谈到试图，你知道的，跨越地域、文化和种族界限，将那些面临经济困境的选民团结起来，

sentences.en: in a way that other candidates don't necessarily.
sentences.zh: 这是其他候选人未必会做到的。

sentences.en: I'm running for president because the time is long overdue for the United States to join every other major country on earth and guarantee health care to
sentences.zh: 我竞选总统是因为美国早该加入世界上所有其他主要国家的行列，通过全民医保单一支付方计划，

sentences.en: all people as a right, not a privilege, through a Medicare for all single payer program.
sentences.zh: 保证所有人都能享有医疗保健，这是一项权利，而不是特权。

sentences.en: You know, his theory is that if you talk about giving people government guaranteed health care,
sentences.zh: 你知道，他的理论是，如果你谈论给人们提供政府保证的医疗保健，

sentences.en: that appeals as much to an African-American woman in Los Angeles as it does to a white coal miner in
sentences.zh: 这既能吸引洛杉矶的非裔美国女性，也能吸引

sentences.en: West Virginia.
sentences.zh: 西弗吉尼亚州的白人煤矿工人。

sentences.en: That theory has not really been tested the way Bernie Sanders would like to test it.
sentences.zh: 这一理论并没有真正按照伯尼·桑德斯所希望的方式接受检验。

sentences.en: There is very, very substantial evidence from the last few rounds of national elections that culture
sentences.zh: 来自过去几轮全国大选的非常、非常大量的证据表明，文化

sentences.en: is such a dominant force in American elections that I think it does cast some doubt on whether that would work in a general election because...
sentences.zh: 是美国选举中如此主导的力量，以至于我认为这确实让人怀疑这在大选中是否行得通，因为……

sentences.en: Together, you and I and our 2016 campaign began the political revolution.
sentences.zh: 在一起，你、我以及我们的2016年竞选团队开启了政治革命。

sentences.en: Now it is time to complete that revolution and implement the vision that we fought for.
sentences.zh: 现在是时候完成这场革命，并落实我们为之奋斗的愿景了。

sentences.en: You know, he's talking about revolution.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他在谈论革命。

sentences.en: That's the word he uses and he uses it for a reason.
sentences.zh: 那是他用的词，而且他使用它是有原因的。

sentences.en: So the question here is, can he run a race that's all about class?
sentences.zh: 所以这里的问题是，他能否进行一场完全关乎阶级的竞选？

sentences.en: And will that work?
sentences.zh: 这会管用吗？

sentences.en: Can he make it all about the 1% versus the 99% and actually succeed?
sentences.zh: 他能把一切都归结为1%对99%并真正成功吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the question is, does the 99% see themselves as a coherent entity?
sentences.zh: 问题是，99%的人是否将自己视为一个有凝聚力的整体？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Or do other kinds of social and cultural divisions make the aspiration to a cross-racial, national workers' campaign just sort of a fantasy?
sentences.zh: 还是说其他种类的社会和文化分歧，让建立一个跨种族、全国性的工人运动的愿望变成了某种幻想？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We'd probably know if there was a 99% club of voters that saw itself as one entity waiting to be tapped.
sentences.zh: 如果真有一个把自己视为一个等待被发掘的整体的99%选民俱乐部，我们大概早就知道了。

sentences.en: Anytime a politician tells you that 80% of people agree strongly with their position on something as sensitive as healthcare or the bedrock nature of the American economy...

sentences.en: They're estimating.

sentences.en: Well, you know, a lot of these people are tricky to categorize ideologically, but I think the person

sentences.en: you would have to put closest to Bernie Sanders, but with some very, very significant philosophical and personal modifications is Elizabeth Warren.

sentences.en: The middle-class squeeze is real, and millions of families can barely breathe.
sentences.zh: 中产阶级的挤压是真实的，数百万家庭几乎喘不过气来。

sentences.en: It is not right.
sentences.zh: 这不对。

sentences.en: She's a candidate who is running a populist campaign.
sentences.zh: 她是一位正在进行民粹主义竞选的候选人。

sentences.en: Hardworking people are up against a small group that holds far too much power, not just in our economy, but also in our democracy.
sentences.zh: 辛勤工作的人民正在对抗一小群掌握了过多权力的人，这些权力不仅存在于我们的经济中，也存在于我们的民主中。

sentences.en: She is targeting banks, insurance companies, pharmaceutical companies.
sentences.zh: 她把矛头指向了银行、保险公司和制药公司。

sentences.en: And when giant corporations and their leaders cheat their customers, stomp out their competitors, and rob their workers, let's prosecute them.
sentences.zh: 当巨型企业及其领导人欺骗客户、扼杀竞争对手并剥夺工人的利益时，让我们起诉他们。

sentences.en: But unlike Bernie Sanders, she's very explicit about calling herself a capitaliSt.

sentences.en: We can't afford just to tinker around the edge as a tax credit here, a regulation there.

sentences.en: That is a huge tonal and substantive difference from Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 这与伯尼·桑德斯在基调和实质上有着巨大的差异。

sentences.en: She's not talking about blowing up and incinerating the entire system and rebuilding it from the ground up.
sentences.zh: 她不是在谈论炸毁和焚烧整个系统并从头开始重建。

sentences.en: She is talking about using all the levers of power in government to take control of a system that she argues is out of control.
sentences.zh: 她谈论的是利用政府权力的所有杠杆来控制一个她认为已经失控的系统。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So cleaning it up, not blowing it up.
sentences.zh: 所以是清理它，而不是炸毁它。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We need to change the rules to clean up Washington, end the corruption.
sentences.zh: 我们需要改变规则以清理华盛顿，终结腐败。

sentences.en: So in that sense, she would be appealing to the Trump voters' same desire to drain the swamp.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，她将迎合特朗普选民想要抽干沼泽的同样愿望。

sentences.en: If there is a drain the swamp candidate in the Democratic primary, it is Elizabeth Warren.
sentences.zh: 如果民主党初选中有一个“抽干沼泽”的候选人，那就是伊丽莎白·沃伦。

sentences.en: Corruption is the central theme of her campaign as much as anything else.
sentences.zh: 腐败是她竞选活动的核心主题，不亚于其他任何事情。

sentences.en: I have proposed the strongest and most comprehensive anti-corruption law since Watergate.
sentences.zh: 我提出了自水门事件以来最强有力、最全面的反腐败法。

sentences.en: But the basic political logic of a Warren campaign is not all that different from the logic of a
sentences.zh: 但沃伦竞选的基本政治逻辑与

sentences.en: Sanders campaign.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯竞选的逻辑并没有太大不同。

sentences.en: It's about harnessing alienation with the political system.
sentences.zh: 这关乎利用对政治体制的疏离感。

sentences.en: It's about telling people that, yeah, you're right, the economy is rigged and I'm going to do something very, very drastic about it.
sentences.zh: 这关乎告诉人们，是的，你说得对，经济被操纵了，我要为此采取非常、非常激烈的行动。

sentences.en: We need to take power in Washington away from the wealthy and well-connected and put it back in the hands of the people where it belongs.
sentences.zh: 我们需要将华盛顿的权力从富有和关系网良好的人手中夺回，并将其放回属于它的人民手中。

sentences.en: Her campaign represents, you know, again, not a Sanders-like rejection of what's normal, but definitely a rejection of what's normal.
sentences.zh: 她的竞选代表了，你知道的，同样不是桑德斯式的对常态的拒绝，但绝对是对常态的拒绝。

sentences.en: So what is the risk of a Warren-like candidate if, by your description, she's kind of a Democratic Trump-like candidate in her attempts to sell herself as a fixer of a
sentences.zh: 那么，像沃伦这样的候选人有什么风险呢？如果按你的描述，她在试图把自己包装成破碎

sentences.en: broken system?
sentences.zh: 系统的修复者时，有点像民主党版的特朗普？

sentences.en: There are a couple of risks in a Warren candidacy.
sentences.zh: 沃伦参选存在着几个风险。

sentences.en: The biggest one is she is putting essentially all her chips on the idea that voters are alienated from the economy and that is going to be the
sentences.zh: 最大的一个是，她基本上把所有的筹码都押在了这样一种观点上，即选民对经济感到疏离，这将成为他们在此次选举中

sentences.en: consuming issue for them in this election.
sentences.zh: 最关切的议题。

sentences.en: It's a bet that people are not just a little bit dissatisfied with how things are working right now, that they are profoundly dissatisfied and that
sentences.zh: 这是一个赌注，赌人们不仅仅是对现状有一点点不满，而是感到深深的不满，并且

sentences.en: whatever other issues they may care about, it's issues about the economy and the power of corporations that matter more than anything else.
sentences.zh: 无论他们还关心什么其他议题，经济和企业权力的议题都比其他任何事情都更重要。

sentences.en: So her focus may be too narrow.
sentences.zh: 所以她的重点可能过于狭隘了。

sentences.en: Well, we just don't know what voters are going to care about most a year from now.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们只是不知道一年后选民最关心的是什么。

sentences.en: And in some ways, it's a daring bet.
sentences.zh: 从某些方面来说，这是一场大胆的赌博。

sentences.en: In some ways, it's a very risky bet to think that these core issues that have been the issues that have defined your career are going to be the
sentences.zh: 从某些方面来看，这是一场非常冒险的赌博，认为这些构成了你的职业生涯的核心议题，将会成为

sentences.en: decisive issues, first in the primary, then in the general election.
sentences.zh: 具有决定性的议题，首先在初选中，然后在全国大选中。

sentences.en: It's not that she only talks about these issues, but, you know, I was in Iowa with her for a day pretty recently, and the balance
sentences.zh: 倒不是说她只谈论这些议题，但是，你知道的，不久前我和她在艾奥瓦州待了一天，而她竞选演讲中

sentences.en: of themes related to corruption and corporate power versus all other themes in her stump speech, it's just overwhelmingly lopsided.
sentences.zh: 涉及腐败和企业权力的主题与所有其他主题的比例，实在是严重失衡。

sentences.en: Who is in the next band over?
sentences.zh: 下一个阵营里都有谁？

sentences.en: So if you think of Sanders and Warren, who are candidates really preoccupied with economic
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想到桑德斯和沃伦，他们是真正全神贯注于经济

sentences.en: populism and whose basic campaign bargain is, let's tax the wealthy and go after corporations
sentences.zh: 民粹主义的候选人，他们基本的竞选主张是，让我们向富人征税并打击大企业

sentences.en: in order to create new welfare benefits for other people, you then get into this next band of candidates and they're a little bit harder to characterize ideologically.
sentences.zh: 以为其他人创造新的福利，那么你就会进入下一个候选人阵营，他们的意识形态特征就更难界定了。

sentences.en: Candidates like
sentences.zh: 像这样的候选人

sentences.en: Kamala Harris and Kirsten Gillibrand, Cory Booker, these are candidates who are all campaigning as liberals and who have endorsed big liberal goals.
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯和克尔斯滕·吉利布兰德、科里·布克，这些候选人在竞选时都打着自由派的旗号，并且支持宏大的自由派目标。

sentences.en: I am running to declare education is a fundamental right.
sentences.zh: 我参选是为了宣布教育是一项基本权利。

sentences.en: I believe that health care should be a right and not a privilege.
sentences.zh: 我相信医疗保健应该是一项权利，而不是特权。

sentences.en: People in America are losing faith that this nation will work for them.
sentences.zh: 美国的民众正在失去对这个国家会为他们服务的信念。

sentences.en: And we will guarantee that right with universal pre-K and debt-free college.
sentences.zh: 我们将通过普及学前教育和无债务大学来保证这一权利。

sentences.en: I believe we should have better public schools because it shouldn't matter what block you grow up on.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们应该拥有更好的公立学校，因为你在哪个街区长大不应该成为影响因素。

sentences.en: My record as a mayor, my record as a senator is fighting those interests that are trying to screw people.
sentences.zh: 我作为市长的记录，我作为参议员的记录，就是与那些试图坑害百姓的利益集团作斗争。

sentences.en: And when it comes to defending folk, I will be ferocious.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到捍卫普通民众时，我会非常凶猛。

sentences.en: But they are much more cautious about the way they talk about enacting that change.
sentences.zh: 但他们对于如何谈论实施这种变革要谨慎得多。

sentences.en: What is your solution to ensure that people have access to quality health care at an affordable price?
sentences.zh: 你确保人们能够以负担得起的价格获得高质量医疗服务的解决方案是什么？

sentences.en: And does that solution involve cutting insurance companies as we know them out of the equation?
sentences.zh: 这个解决方案是否包括把我们所知的保险公司从这个公式中剔除？

sentences.en: We saw this very memorably with Kamala Harris in her first few days as a candidate when she first, in a CNN event, endorsed getting rid of the private health care system entirely.
sentences.zh: 我们在卡玛拉·哈里斯作为候选人的最初几天里非常难忘地看到了这一点，当时她在CNN的一个活动中首次支持彻底废除私人医疗保健系统。

sentences.en: I believe the solution, and I actually feel very strongly about this, is that we need to have Medicare for all.
sentences.zh: 我相信这个解决方案，而且我对此实际上感触很深，那就是我们需要实行全民医保。

sentences.en: That's just the bottom line.
sentences.zh: 这就是底线。

sentences.en: It's a Bernie Sanders-like position.
sentences.zh: 这是一个类似伯尼·桑德斯的立场。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: Senator Harris is now backtracking a bit on her call to eliminate private health insurers.
sentences.zh: 参议员哈里斯现在对她消除私人医疗保险的呼吁进行了一些回缩。

sentences.en: Her spokesman tells us she is open to more moderate plans that preserve the private health care industry.
sentences.zh: 她的发言人告诉我们，她对保留私人医疗保健行业的更温和计划持开放态度。

sentences.en: Quickly clarified that she favors any number of ways of getting to universal health care coverage, not necessarily the Bernie Sanders approach.
sentences.zh: 迅速澄清说她赞成通过各种方式实现全民医保覆盖，而不一定采取伯尼·桑德斯的方法。

sentences.en: Her signature economic proposal is a big tax cut.
sentences.zh: 她标志性的经济提案是一项大规模减税。

sentences.en: We will deliver the largest working and middle class tax cut in a generation.
sentences.zh: 我们将实施一代人中最大规模的工薪阶层和中产阶级减税。

sentences.en: Targeted at the middle class, paid for by increasing taxes and changing the kinds of taxes that are applied to much wealthier people.
sentences.zh: 以中产阶级为目标，通过增加税收和改变适用于更富有的人的税种来支付。

sentences.en: We'll pay for it by reversing this administration's giveaways to the top 50...
sentences.zh: 我们将通过撤销本届政府给前50名……的馈赠来支付这笔费用

sentences.en: That is a much more conventional way of thinking about how you gain credibility on the economy.
sentences.zh: 关于如何在经济问题上获得信誉，这是一种传统得多的思考方式。

sentences.en: Our planet is in peril, and we need to be bold.
sentences.zh: 我们的星球处于危险之中，我们需要大胆。

sentences.en: It's one of the reasons why I signed on to the resolution and co-sponsored the resolution for the Green New Deal.
sentences.zh: 这也是我签署该决议并共同发起绿色新政决议的原因之一。

sentences.en: I think that once you get to Cory Booker, you're even a couple clicks closer to the political center.
sentences.zh: 我认为，一旦你看到科里·布克，你就会离政治中心更近那么几步。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of people now that are blowing back on the Green New Deal.
sentences.zh: 现在有很多人对绿色新政进行回击。

sentences.en: They're like, oh, it's impractical.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得，哦，这不切实际。

sentences.en: Oh, it's too expensive.
sentences.zh: 哦，这太贵了。

sentences.en: Oh, it's all of this.
sentences.zh: 哦，诸如此类。

sentences.en: If we used to govern our dreams that way, we would have never gone to the moon.
sentences.zh: 如果我们过去以这种方式管理我们的梦想，我们永远不会登上月球。

sentences.en: God, that's impractical.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这太不切实际了。

sentences.en: You see that ball in the sky?
sentences.zh: 你看到天上的那个球了吗？

sentences.en: He endorses the Green New Deal as sort of an aspirational goal.
sentences.zh: 他支持绿色新政，将其作为一种抱负般的目标。

sentences.en: But he doesn't endorse the full program, wouldn't expect to enact it as president.
sentences.zh: 但他并不支持完整的纲领，也不会指望作为总统将其颁布实施。

sentences.en: And my parents taught me, reach for the moon, reach for the stars.
sentences.zh: 我的父母教导我，要志存高远，要摘星揽月。

sentences.en: Even if you come up short, at least you're going to be hovering above the ground.
sentences.zh: 即使你没有完全达到目标，至少你也会悬浮在地面之上。

sentences.en: You'll be soaring, young man.
sentences.zh: 你会翱翔的，年轻人。

sentences.en: He is somebody who you start to hear speaking in more pragmatic terms about simply what he considers possible in a divided government.
sentences.zh: 他开始用更加务实的词汇来谈论他在一个分裂的政府中所认为可能的简单事情。

sentences.en: And when the planet has been in peril in the past, who came forward to save Earth from the scourge of Nazi and totalitarian regimes?
sentences.zh: 过去当星球处于危险之中时，是谁挺身而出，将地球从纳粹和极权政权的灾难中拯救出来？

sentences.en: We came forward.
sentences.zh: 我们挺身而出。

sentences.en: I imagine that the idea for this group of Democratic candidates is to appeal to every conceivable voter by seeming pragmatic and flexible, a bit malleable.
sentences.zh: 我想这群民主党候选人的想法是通过显得务实、灵活、有点可塑性，来吸引每一个可以想象得到的选民。

sentences.en: But I imagine that the risk here is gaining a reputation for being inauthentic, maybe even phony.
sentences.zh: 但我猜这里的风险是获得不真诚、甚至虚伪的名声。

sentences.en: Yeah, the risk is that you end up trying to be all things to all people and being nothing in particular to anybody.
sentences.zh: 是的，风险在于你最终试图迎合所有人，结果对谁都不是真正重要。

sentences.en: And this is a particularly pointed distinction on economic issues and issues related to inequality and corporate power.
sentences.zh: 在经济问题以及与不平等和企业权力相关的问题上，这是一个特别尖锐的区别。

sentences.en: That if you're a candidate who talks big on taking on health insurance companies, taking on banks, making sure that, you know, the 99 percent start catching up with the 1 percent,
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个夸夸其谈要对付医疗保险公司、对付银行、确保你知道的99%的人开始赶上1%的人的候选人，

sentences.en: people might at some point expect you to propose policy ideas that would actually achieve that outcome.
sentences.zh: 人们在某些时候可能会期待你提出真正能实现这一结果的政策理念。

sentences.en: And there's a great risk in being seen as a candidate who endorses a bunch of very grand liberal goals.
sentences.zh: 被视为一个支持一堆非常宏大的自由派目标的候选人，存在着巨大的风险。

sentences.en: And then there's always a but.
sentences.zh: 而且总有一个“但是”。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I'm thinking, of course, of Hillary Clinton taking Wall Street money while calling for Wall Street reform.
sentences.zh: 我当然想到了希拉里·克林顿在呼吁华尔街改革的同时接受华尔街的资金。

sentences.en: If there's one consistent theme we've seen in politics over the last few years in both parties, it's the importance of personal and ideological authenticity.
sentences.zh: 如果我们看到过去几年两党政治中有一个贯穿始终的主题，那就是个人和意识形态真实性的重要性。

sentences.en: And that is something that Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren obviously have in spades.
sentences.zh: 而这正是伯尼·桑德斯和伊丽莎白·沃伦显然极其具备的。

sentences.en: And once you start to get to candidates who are trying to bridge divides in the party, it just becomes more complicated.
sentences.zh: 一旦你开始接触那些试图弥合党内分歧的候选人，事情就变得更加复杂了。

sentences.en: If you are Donald Trump,
sentences.zh: 如果你是唐纳德·特朗普，

sentences.en: what you're hoping for is a Democratic candidate who will either be so far left that they cannot appeal to the middle or a candidate who has tied themselves into an ideological pretzel and who you can just ridicule as inauthentic.
sentences.zh: 你所希望的是一个民主党候选人，要么左得无法吸引中间派，要么是一个把自己绑在意识形态怪圈中、你可以嘲笑其不真诚的候选人。

sentences.en: I don't think there's anybody in the Democratic race at this point who has reached that pretzel status.
sentences.zh: 我不认为目前民主党竞选中有谁达到了那种怪圈状态。

sentences.en: But we will see, especially for these candidates who are trying to straddle to the left and the center,
sentences.zh: 但我们会拭目以待，特别是对于这些试图跨越左翼和中间派的候选人来说，

sentences.en: who are trying to be both revolutionary and exciting and also non-threatening to voters who are more traditional voters,
sentences.zh: 他们既想具有革命性和激昂感，又想对那些更传统的选民不具有威胁性，

sentences.en: a long primary is going to test whether the core of who they are really fits that description.
sentences.zh: 一场漫长的初选将考验他们骨子里是否真的符合这种描述。

sentences.en: So you're kind of tracking pretzel status.
sentences.zh: 所以你有点在追踪怪圈状态。

sentences.en: So that leaves us with the actual moderates.
sentences.zh: 这给我们留下了真正的温和派。

sentences.en: And who are they so far?
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，他们是谁？

sentences.en: Well, right now— For too long, leaders in Washington have sat on the sidelines while others tried to figure out what to do about the changing economy and its impact on our lives.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在——华盛顿的领导人们作壁上观太久了，而其他人却在试图弄清楚如何应对不断变化的经济及其对我们生活的影响。

sentences.en: There's really only one major candidate in the race who is positioning herself very directly as a moderate, and that's Amy Klobuchar.
sentences.zh: 竞选中真正只有一个主要候选人非常直接地将自己定位为温和派，那就是阿米·克洛布查尔。

sentences.en: We have seen her, more than any other candidate, willing to just say no to some of the really big liberal trophy ideas like Medicare for All, like free college.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到，比任何其他候选人都更愿意对一些真正重大的自由派战利品理念说不，比如全民医保，比如免费大学。

sentences.en: Yes or no?
sentences.zh: 是要还是不要？

sentences.en: Would you support free college for all?
sentences.zh: 你会支持全民免费大学吗？

sentences.en: I am not for free four-year college for all.
sentences.zh: 我不支持所有人免费读四年制大学。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We have talked about candidates who say yes, but—but she's a candidate who just says no.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论过那些说“要”的候选人，但是——她是一个直截了当说“不”的候选人。

sentences.en: I wish if I was a magic genie and could give that to everyone and we could afford it, I would.
sentences.zh: 我希望如果我是一个神仙，能把这个给每个人并且我们负担得起，我会的。

sentences.en: I'm just trying to find a mix of incentives.
sentences.zh: 我只是在寻找一系列激励措施的组合。

sentences.en: And we're going to see whether there's an appetite for that in the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 我们将看看民主党内对此是否有胃口。

sentences.en: Somebody who says, I'm just going to level with you.
sentences.zh: 一个说，我只是要跟你实话实说的人。

sentences.en: I'm not going to do that because I don't think it's possible.
sentences.zh: 我不会那样做，因为我认为这不可能。

sentences.en: Here are the things I am going to do.
sentences.zh: 以下是我将要做的事情。

sentences.en: Getting to universal health care and bringing down, bringing down the cost of prescription drugs.
sentences.zh: 实现全民医疗保健并降低处方药的成本。

sentences.en: It's a bet that voters will reward candor and realism.
sentences.zh: 这是一场赌博，赌选民会奖励直率和现实主义。

sentences.en: Look, if you're Amy Klobuchar, you're taking a big risk on the idea that voters will accept less if they think that they can get it for sure,
sentences.zh: 听着，如果你是阿米·克洛布查尔，你就在冒着巨大的风险，赌选民如果认为他们肯定能得到的话，会接受较少的东西，

sentences.en: as opposed to promising them more with some uncertainty about whether it's achievable.
sentences.zh: 而不是向他们承诺更多却不确定是否能够实现。

sentences.en: It is time to organize, time to galvanize, time to take back our democracy.
sentences.zh: 是时候组织起来了，是时候激发活力了，是时候夺回我们的民主了。

sentences.en: It's time, America.
sentences.zh: 是时候了，美国。

sentences.en: A really significant portion of the Democratic Party self-identifies as moderate, not conservative, but they are suspicious of Medicare for all.
sentences.zh: 民主党中相当大的一部分人自认为温和派，不是保守派，但他们对全民医保心存怀疑。

sentences.en: They are suspicious of some of the really grand transformational promises that they hear from the more liberal candidates.
sentences.zh: 他们对从更自由的候选人那里听到的一些真正宏大的变革承诺持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: And right now, if you split up the pie on the left between the candidates we've talked about, there is a big slice of pie left closer to the political center.
sentences.zh: 目前，如果你把我们谈论的候选人之间的左翼蛋糕分块，靠近政治中心的地方还剩下一大块蛋糕。

sentences.en: And Amy Klobuchar is the only person, with the possible exception of Cory Booker, who's going right at it.
sentences.zh: 而阿米·克洛布查尔是唯一一个（可能除了科里·布克之外）直接奔向它的人。

sentences.en: So the space that she's in could get crowded if suddenly Joe Biden runs and Mike Bloomberg runs and Terry McAuliffe or John Hickenlooper,
sentences.zh: 所以她所处的空间可能会变得拥挤，如果乔·拜登突然参选，迈克·布隆伯格参选，或者前弗吉尼亚州长和科罗拉多州长特里·麦考利夫或约翰·希肯卢珀参选的话，

sentences.en: former governors from Virginia and Colorado, run.
sentences.zh: 来自弗吉尼亚州和科罗拉多州的前州长参选。

sentences.en: Then she won't be alone.
sentences.zh: 那她就不会孤单了。

sentences.en: That middle space could get real crowded.
sentences.zh: 中间的空间可能会变得非常拥挤。

sentences.en: Alex, more broadly,
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，更广泛地说，

sentences.en: it feels like the risk here in the Democrats building their message and their platforms around the economy and running against President Trump is that the economy is doing pretty well.
sentences.zh: 感觉民主党人围绕经济构建他们的信息和纲领并与特朗普总统竞争的风险在于，经济状况相当不错。

sentences.en: Isn't it possible that in a year or so, if the economy stays doing this well,
sentences.zh: 难道在一两年内，如果经济保持这种良好状态，

sentences.en: that voters are going to look around and see all of the Democratic Party promising to blow things up and they're going to think to themselves,
sentences.zh: 选民环顾四周，看到整个民主党都在承诺把事情搞砸，他们会想，

sentences.en: I don't want to blow up this system that's working reasonably well for me.
sentences.zh: 我不想搞砸这个对我来说运转相当不错的系统。

sentences.en: It's entirely possible.
sentences.zh: 完全有可能。

sentences.en: And one of the ironies of the race that we're seeing so far is Donald Trump as kind of a status quo candidate,
sentences.zh: 我们目前看到的竞选的讽刺之处之一是，唐纳德·特朗普有点像一个维持现状的候选人，

sentences.en: as a let's not shake things up too much candidate on the specific issue of the economy.
sentences.zh: 在经济这个具体问题上，他是一个不要把事情搞得太乱的候选人。

sentences.en: He's obviously not that kind of candidate or president more generally.
sentences.zh: 他显然不是那种候选人或更广泛意义上的总统。

sentences.en: But this is also a place where in some ways Democrats are taking a lesson from Trump's candidacy in 2016.
sentences.zh: 但这也是民主党人在某些方面借鉴特朗普2016年竞选经验的地方。

sentences.en: I think we all remember when Trump was out there talking about make America great again, that one of the really big Democratic applause lines was America is already great.
sentences.zh: 我想我们都记得当特朗普出来谈论让美国再次伟大时，民主党真正的一个巨大掌声点是美国已经很伟大了。

sentences.en: And it turns out that a lot of voters did not agree with that.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，很多选民并不赞同这一点。

sentences.en: And the president is counting on that working for him in 2020.
sentences.zh: 总统正指望这在2020年为他发挥作用。

sentences.en: So make America's economy greater could basically be the Democratic Party slogan for 2020.
sentences.zh: 因此，让美国的经济更加伟大基本上可以成为民主党2020年的口号。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: The core of the Democratic message in 2020 will almost certainly be about the economy unless we have some kind of catastrophic intervening event.
sentences.zh: 2020年民主党的核心信息几乎肯定是关于经济的，除非我们发生某种灾难性的干预事件。

sentences.en: That nobody is hoping for.
sentences.zh: 没有人希望发生这种事。

sentences.en: And because they feel that the economic message is what was missing last time, they all basically agree with each other.
sentences.zh: 因为他们觉得经济信息是上次所缺少的，所以他们基本上都彼此同意。

sentences.en: And they all basically agree with Hillary Clinton on social and cultural issues that are at the heart of American politics.
sentences.zh: 在处于美国政治核心的社会和文化问题上，他们基本上都同意希拉里·克林顿的看法。

sentences.en: And they all disagree strongly with Donald Trump on those issues where they don't agree with each other and where the party has not yet found its identity on the national level is on these economic issues.
sentences.zh: 在他们意见不一致以及该党尚未在国家层面找到自身身份的这些经济问题上，他们与唐纳德·特朗普强烈不一致。

sentences.en: And it's where they don't know where the country is.
sentences.zh: 这也是他们不知道国家在哪里的时候。

sentences.en: It's where they don't know where a controlling coalition of voters can be found.
sentences.zh: 这也是他们不知道在哪里可以找到控制选民联盟的时候。

sentences.en: They know what it looks like to win a midterm election with an economic message.
sentences.zh: 他们知道带着经济信息赢得中期选举是什么样子的。

sentences.en: They know what it looks like to lose a presidential election with a weak economic message.
sentences.zh: 他们知道带着微弱的经济信息输掉总统选举是什么样子的。

sentences.en: They don't yet know what it means to put together a winning message on the economy in the Trump era in a presidential race.
sentences.zh: 他们还不知道在特朗普时代的总统竞选中，拼凑出一个关于经济的获胜信息意味着什么。

sentences.en: Alex, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月而无需输入信用卡，会怎么样？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: A Times investigation has uncovered several previously unknown attempts by President Trump to impede federal investigations into his administration's conduct.
sentences.zh: 《时报》的一项调查发现，特朗普总统曾多次进行此前不为人知的尝试，以阻挠联邦对他的政府行为的调查。

sentences.en: In one case, Trump suggested that his acting attorney general, Matt Whitaker,
sentences.zh: 在一个案例中，特朗普建议他的代理总检察长马特·惠特克，

sentences.en: install a Trump ally to oversee an investigation into his hush money payments to two women who said they had affairs with Trump.
sentences.zh: 安插一名特朗普的盟友来监督一项调查，内容是关于他向两名自称与特朗普有染的女性支付封口费的事。

sentences.en: In another case, Trump had private conversations with Republican lawmakers, including Representative Matt Gaetz, about a campaign to attack the special counsel, Robert Mueller,
sentences.zh: 在另一个案例中，特朗普与包括众议员马特·盖茨在内的共和党议员进行了私下对话，内容是关于一场攻击特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒的运动，

sentences.en: and use the lawmakers' congressional oversight power to try to undercut Mueller.
sentences.zh: 并试图利用议员们的国会监督权力来削弱穆勒。

sentences.en: The lawmakers, the Times found, did just that.
sentences.zh: 《时报》发现，议员们正是这么做的。

sentences.en: And the federal judge handling the case of Roger Stone, a longtime Trump advisor charged with lying to federal prosecutors in the Russia investigation,
sentences.zh: 负责罗杰·斯通一案的联邦法官正在要求知道为什么斯通在Instagram上发布了一张带有威胁性的照片，其中包括法官的特写照片、她的名字，

sentences.en: is demanding to know why Stone posted a menacing photo on Instagram that included a close-up picture of the judge, her name,
sentences.zh: 罗杰·斯通是特朗普的长期顾问，被控在俄罗斯调查中对联邦检察官撒谎。

sentences.en: and what appeared to be the crosshairs of a gun near her head.
sentences.zh: 以及她头部附近似乎是枪支准星的图案。

sentences.en: The judge ordered a special court hearing set for tomorrow to address the image, which Stone has since apologized for and deleted.
sentences.zh: 法官下令于明天召开一次特别法庭听证会来处理这张图片，斯通事后已就此道歉并将其删除。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人家做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的诀窍。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、一关灯就能睡着的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们喝断片了去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有食物过敏或敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》App或您喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索收听《Wirecutter秀》。
